entries.name: TEST_Gloomcrab
entries.text:
TEST_Gloomcrab
Medium beast, unaligned

Armor Class 13 (natural armor)
Hit Points 11 (2d8 + 2)
Speed 20 ft., swim 20 ft.

STR 12 (+1) DEX 10 (+0) CON 12 (+1) INT 2 (-4) WIS 10 (+0) CHA 3 (-4)

Skills Stealth +2
Senses darkvision 60 ft., passive Perception 10
Languages —
Challenge 1/4 (50 XP)

Amphibious. The gloomcrab can breathe air and water.

Actions
Claw. Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d6 + 2) bludgeoning damage, and the target is grappled (escape DC 11). A grappled adventurer’s pack is at risk — the crab pries at its straps.

entries.name: TEST_Ashen Warden
entries.text:
TEST_Ashen Warden
Large construct, lawful neutral

Armor Class 17 (natural armor)
Hit Points 76 (9d10 + 27)
Speed 30 ft.

STR 18 (+4) DEX 9 (-1) CON 16 (+3) INT 6 (-2) WIS 12 (+1) CHA 5 (-3)

Saving Throws Con +6, Wis +4
Damage Resistances fire
Damage Immunities poison
Condition Immunities charmed, poisoned
Senses darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 11
Languages understands Common but can’t speak
Challenge 5 (1,800 XP)

Magic Resistance. The warden has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions
Multiattack. The warden makes two slam attacks.
Slam. Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage.

Reactions
Ember Shield. When a creature within 5 feet of the warden hits it with a melee attack, the attacker takes 3 (1d6) fire damage.

Legendary Actions
The warden can take 2 legendary actions, choosing from the options below. Only one legendary action option can be used at a time and only at the end of another creature’s turn. The warden regains spent legendary actions at the start of its turn.
Slam. The warden makes one slam attack.
Cinder Step (Costs 2 Actions). The warden moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
